resources.string: This browser keeps the household in its own storage. If the site\'s data is cleared, or the browser runs short of room, it can disappear: save a backup now and then.
This browser does not let Fulla keep anything once the page is closed (a private window?). Open Fulla in a normal window, and save a backup before you leave.
Add Fulla to your home screen
On an iPhone: tap the Share button in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”. Fulla then opens like an app, works without a connection, and the browser is less likely to clear its data.
Everything stays in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
This household lives only in this browser, so a backup file is its only other copy. Save one now and then, and keep it somewhere that is not this device.
No backup has been saved in a while. A backup protects the household if the browser\'s data is ever cleared.
Removes the household from this browser.
This household only exists in this browser. Forgetting it deletes it for good, unless you saved a backup. Continue?
